usages.explain: Used to convey information heard to others, implying that the content may not be accurate.

examples.content: 砂糖さんとかいう女の人が訪ねてきていますよ。
examples.transcription: さとうさんとかいうおんなのひとがたずねてきていますよ。
examples.mean: A woman called Ms. Sugar is visiting.

examples.content: 小林さんは今朝熱があって休むとか。
examples.transcription: こばやしさんはけさねつがあってやすむとか。
examples.mean: Mr. Kobayashi has a fever this morning and will be taking a rest.

title: ...とか (いう) ... => ...or something like that, it's called...
